Instructions
fields.options:
How it works
  • Only the domain's home page is redirected: opening https://<domain>/ goes to its Redirect To page. Every other link on that domain opens as usual.
  • The domains come from this site only, never from the other sites on the bench: the site name, the site config (host_name, domains), Frappe Cloud when the site is connected to it, and any domain the site has been opened on (Detected).
  • Domains cannot be typed in or deleted. To stop a domain's redirect, untick Enabled or clear Redirect To.
To add a domain
  1. Add the domain to this site in Frappe Cloud (Site → Domains) and wait for it to become Active.
  2. Open the domain once in a browser, or open this page on that domain and click Sync Domains. It then appears in the table.
  3. Fill Redirect To with the page path, e.g. /nlsatadmissions or /nlsat-international, tick Enabled and Save. It works at once, without a deploy.
Warnings
  • The Primary domain cannot be redirected; staff reach the desk through it.
  • Do not redirect a domain that staff use to open the desk: its home page will open the redirect page instead.
  • Redirect To must be a page of this site starting with / (not / itself and not another website). Check the page opens before saving.
  • Page Status is checked on save and every day. If the page is deleted or renamed later, it shows Not Found, an entry is added to the Error Log, and the domain opens its normal home page instead of a Page Not Found until Redirect To is fixed.
  • Login is separate per domain: being logged in on one domain does not log the user in on another.
  • Untick Enable Domain Redirects to turn every redirect off at once if something goes wrong.
